metadata.question: Was there an active fire present in Monte Pisano in Northern Italy between February 24, 2019 and February 26, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to detect active fires in Monte Pisano, Northern Italy between Feb 24-26, 2019. - Best dataset: MODIS Active Fires (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) or VIIRS Active Fires (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML) - Location: Monte Pisano in Northern Italy - need to define a geometry around this area - Date: 2019-02-24 to 2019-02-26 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for fire detection datasets - they already provide fire detection confidence 3. Logic: - Check if any fire pixels exist in the collection during the time period - If collection size is 0 -> C1 - If fire pixels exist -> A (Yes), else -> B (No) Let me use VIIRS as it has better spatial resolution than MODIS for fire detection. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Monte Pisano area in Northern Italy (approximate bounding box) const geometry = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [10.4, 43.7], [10.6, 43.7], [10.6, 43.8], [10.4, 43.8], [10.4, 43.7] ]); const startDate = '2019-02-24'; const endDate = '2019-02-26'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Active Fires const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(geometry); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detection images found: ${collectionSize}`); // Check for empty collection if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No fire detection data available for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire pixels // Create a binary mask for fire pixels (confidence > 0) const fireMask = fireCollection.map(function(image) { return image.select('Confidence').gt(0); }); // Combine all fire masks and count total fire pixels const totalFireMask = fireMask.sum(); const fireCount = totalFireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Confidence').getInfo(); console.log(`Total fire pixels detected: ${fireCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined) { console.log("C3"); } else if (fireCount > 0) { console.log("Active fires detected in the area."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No active fires detected in the area."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
